nodes.label: alignments_human2mouse_all
nodes.rationale: Reference set of all high-confidence 1:1 orthologs, filtered on mouse orthology confidence = high.

nodes.label: clean_feat
nodes.rationale: Derived from feature_dictionary (single source of truth) so plot labels never drift.

nodes.label: feature_dictionary
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for feature labels: raw column name -> readable label; feature_name_original for selecting columns, feature_name only for plot labels.

nodes.label: lasso_plot
nodes.rationale: Penalized estimates have no valid SE/CI, so only points are plotted.

nodes.label: deg_filter
nodes.rationale: human = genes differentially expressed in humans (primary); any/all are sensitivity universes.

nodes.label: df_all
nodes.rationale: Primary modelling table: relevance = dual_rank, convergence = rank_diff, conv_rel combines both.

nodes.label: direction_res
nodes.rationale: Directional concordance.

nodes.label: gene_annotated_layers
nodes.rationale: Gene-level feature layers (sequence evolution, TFs, cCREs, BTMs) per gene.

nodes.label: loco_regression
nodes.rationale: Generic LOCO regression fitting LM + Lasso + RF + NN; uses leave-one-condition-out cross-validation rather than in-sample metrics. glmnet requires >= 2 predictors, so Lasso is skipped when only one is available.

nodes.label: observed_vs_predicted
nodes.rationale: Table for exploration (plot, threshold, select genes).

nodes.label: rank_res
nodes.rationale: Mouse-to-human rank transfer.

nodes.label: ranks_df
nodes.rationale: Absolute rank = percentile of |log2FC| x -log10(adjusted P) per condition; high rank = strong AND significant change (direction ignored).

nodes.label: safe_cor_test
nodes.rationale: A correlation function robust to low n and zero variance.

nodes.label: results_quartiles
nodes.rationale: Tests whether BTMs with higher mouse NES show greater human validation precision.

nodes.label: cres_type_homology_comparison_dge_legs_stats
nodes.rationale: Annotated with gene expression and LEG status to relate CRE architecture to cross-species expression divergence.

nodes.label: gene_attribute_chea_clean
nodes.rationale: ChEA3 TF-target matrix transformed to long format keeping only positive scores; species detected from method/tissue/species metadata.

nodes.label: gene_attribute_tf_count
nodes.rationale: Counts evidence per (gene, TF) pair across species and flags whether a TF regulates a gene in both organisms.

nodes.label: btm_ranks
nodes.rationale: Absolute ranks recomputed WITHIN mouse LEGs (classification scope).

nodes.label: df_mouse_legs
nodes.rationale: Keep only Shared and Mouse-only genes, so both classes are mouse LEGs. This controls for mouse LEG status and isolates what makes a mouse LEG shared.

nodes.label: df_shared
nodes.rationale: status_original is module-specific, so collapse to one row per gene and condition; a gene is labelled Shared if it is a shared LEG in at least one module.

nodes.label: loco_classification
nodes.rationale: Generic LOCO classification fitting logistic + Lasso + RF + NN; binary factor ordered FALSE < TRUE. glmnet requires >= 2 predictors, so Lasso is skipped when only one is available.

nodes.label: min_max
nodes.rationale: Robust min-max scaling that tolerates zero-variance groups.

nodes.label: shared_res_A
nodes.rationale: Framing A = predictive (keeps mouse expression).

nodes.label: shared_res_B
nodes.rationale: Framing B = explanatory (no mouse magnitude).

nodes.label: eset_human_mouse
nodes.rationale: Human and mouse matrices are joined by gene symbol and quantile normalised so that the joint ExpressionSet is directly comparable across species.

nodes.label: arrayWeights
nodes.rationale: Estimate sample-specific quality weights; down-weights arrays with excessive noise to improve statistical power.

nodes.label: duplicateCorrelation
nodes.rationale: Estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject (paired-samples).

nodes.label: eBayes
nodes.rationale: Apply empirical Bayes moderation to shrink gene-wise variances toward a common value: improves stability for low-variance genes.

nodes.label: fit2 (eBayes)
nodes.rationale: Empirical Bayes moderation with trend and robust options shrinks gene-wise variances for stable DEG estimates.

nodes.label: lmFit
nodes.rationale: Use inter-subject correlation as input into the linear model fit.

nodes.label: topTreat
nodes.rationale: Tests whether log2FC exceeds a minimum threshold, not just non-zero.

nodes.label: t.test
nodes.rationale: Paired/unpaired t-test per gene vs baseline; wrapped in tryCatch to return NA for genes with insufficient observations.

nodes.label: Combine Human/Mouse DEG Results
nodes.rationale: Combine differential expression results from human and mouse datasets for cross-species comparison.

nodes.label: Subsampling Stability Loop
nodes.rationale: Run the subsampling loop to assess the impact of cohort composition on differential expression results.

nodes.label: Biological Null Distribution
nodes.rationale: Duchenne Day 28 used as a biological negative control for cross-species comparison.

nodes.label: corfit (duplicateCorrelation)
nodes.rationale: Intra-individual correlation is estimated from repeated measures so it can be supplied to the linear model for paired-samples designs.

nodes.label: draw_flexible_subset
nodes.rationale: Defensive longitudinal subsampling ensures every drawn sub-cohort contains all timepoints and yields a full-rank design matrix before Limma is run.

nodes.label: eset_filtered
nodes.rationale: Low-expressed genes are removed by keeping only genes with log2 intensity > 6 in at least 5 samples.

nodes.label: fluad_human_subsampled_degs
nodes.rationale: Results are aggregated by median across 200 subsampling iterations to obtain robust DEG estimates independent of cohort composition.

nodes.label: cres_annotated
nodes.rationale: Full join preserves orphan CREs on both sides so species-specific elements are retained.

nodes.label: cres_mouse
nodes.rationale: No CTCF-bound CREs in main full CRE mouse dataset, so mouse CREs imported separately and CTCF overlaps removed before merge.

nodes.label: cres_type_homology_comparison
nodes.rationale: Mouse type is not filtered so that Species Specific cCREs are not lost; granular homology collapsed into Homologous / Complex homology / Species Specific.

nodes.label: genes_cres_human
nodes.rationale: CTCF-bound cCREs not annotated accordingly were removed from PLS and pELS-dELS before merging.

nodes.label: homologous_cres
nodes.rationale: Homologous CRE pairs from ENCODE (hg38-mm10) nearest gene, protein coding only.

nodes.label: calculate_pairwise_dna_distance
nodes.rationale: Computes pairwise DNA distance (JC69, K80) between human and mouse CDS pairs.

nodes.label: fetch_mouse_cds_chunked
nodes.rationale: Processes mouse CDS gene chunks in batches of 100 to keep BioMart requests safe/resumable.

nodes.label: human_cds_clean
nodes.rationale: BioMart returns multiple rows per gene due to alternative splicing transcripts; longest sequence per stable gene ID is picked to avoid truncation artifacts.

nodes.label: mouse_cds_clean
nodes.rationale: BioMart returns multiple rows per gene due to alternative splicing transcripts; longest sequence per stable gene ID is picked to avoid truncation artifacts.

nodes.label: priority_genes_heatmap
nodes.rationale: Clustered heatmap of the prioritized relevant-convergent genes.

nodes.label: priority_list
nodes.rationale: Candidate genes filtered on dual_rank >= 75, rank_diff <= 25, p_adj_mouse <= 0.05, ranked by conv_rel.

nodes.label: score_tbl
nodes.rationale: Each score is an out-of-fold model prediction (leave-one-condition-out); score_translational = score_rank * score_direction.

nodes.label: autoGSEA
nodes.rationale: Runs GSEA once on the combined conditions to produce a single unified output.

nodes.label: difflog2fc_distance_scatter_plot
nodes.rationale: Tests whether the absolute difference in Log2FC is explained by sequence distance.

nodes.label: distance_legs_plot
nodes.rationale: Tests whether LEG status is explained by evolutionary distance in the CDS (Kimura distance).

nodes.label: dge_btm_process_genes_diff_bygene_clean_filtered
nodes.rationale: Shared cross-species per-gene differential expression statistics reused across the evolutionary and modelling notebooks.

nodes.label: all_degs_human_mouse
nodes.rationale: Limma differential expression results used to derive the human DEG gene set.

nodes.label: human_degs
nodes.rationale: Human differentially expressed gene symbol vector used to restrict PCA and correlation inputs.

nodes.label: fetch_cds_chunked
nodes.rationale: Fetches coding sequences in chunks with useCache = FALSE to prevent dbDisconnect / .lock2 SQLite errors.

nodes.label: 1.1_QualityControl.qmd
nodes.rationale: Quality-control notebook comparing human and mouse blood transcriptomic responses across multiple pathogens, assessing normalization (raw vs quantile), distribution, correlation and PCA.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn
nodes.rationale: Raw and quantile-normalized expression values, used as input for expression PCA.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg
nodes.rationale: Averaged expression values used for averaged distribution violin boxes.

nodes.label: all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc
nodes.rationale: Pan-pathogen log2FC sample table imported for Hepatitis B, Influenza, S. aureus, E. coli, Burn and Trauma analyses.

nodes.label: all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated
nodes.rationale: Log2FC table joined with metadata so each sample carries organism/timepoint/participant annotations.

nodes.label: annotation_samples_pca
nodes.rationale: Sample-to-metadata lookup used to colour PCA points.

nodes.label: clean_matrix_log2fc
nodes.rationale: Sample-by-gene log2FC matrix used for PCA on fold-change rather than expression.

nodes.label: clean_matrix_qn
nodes.rationale: Sample-by-gene matrix of quantile-normalized values prepared for PCA to compare against raw.

nodes.label: clean_matrix_raw
nodes.rationale: Sample-by-gene matrix of raw values with non-finite entries set to 0 before PCA.

nodes.label: colors palette object
nodes.rationale: Central colour palette (organism, timepoint, comparison) reused across plots.

nodes.label: cor_human_human
nodes.rationale: Within-human participant pairwise correlations per timepoint.

nodes.label: cor_human_mouse_timepoint
nodes.rationale: Human vs Mouse Pearson correlations computed for each matched timepoint pair across all participant pairs.

nodes.label: cor_mouse_mouse
nodes.rationale: Within-mouse participant pairwise correlations per timepoint.

nodes.label: correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary
nodes.rationale: Combine Human-vs-Mouse, Human-vs-Human and Mouse-vs-Mouse correlation summaries for shared timepoints.

nodes.label: correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary_plot
nodes.rationale: Line plot of mean Pearson correlation over time with 95% CI error bars for each comparison type.

nodes.label: distribution_check_avg_plot
nodes.rationale: Density plot of averaged expression by organism and timepoint.

nodes.label: distribution_check_log2fc_plot
nodes.rationale: Density plot of log2FC by organism and timepoint, overlaid by organism.

nodes.label: distribution_check_subject_plot
nodes.rationale: Kaboxplot overlaying per-subject IQR boxes with quantile lines to compare subject distributions.

nodes.label: distribution_check_subject_raw_qn_log2fc_all
nodes.rationale: Composite 2x2 patch of subject and averaged expression/log2FC distributions.

nodes.label: human_correlation_ggpairs_alldays
nodes.rationale: GGally ggpairs matrix of pairwise human-human correlations across all timepoints.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc
nodes.rationale: Per-sample log2 fold change data for raw and quantile-normalized influenza values, the base table for distribution and correlation analysis.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg
nodes.rationale: Gene-level averaged log2FC/effect-size table used for volcano and cross-species correlation plots.

nodes.label: human_mouse_metadata
nodes.rationale: Sample metadata (participant, organism, timepoint, sex, age) joined to expression tables.

nodes.label: long_expr
nodes.rationale: Per-pathogen filtered annotated expression table (long format).

nodes.label: long_expr_log2fc_avg
nodes.rationale: Gene-level summary aggregating mean/sd/se of expression, log2FC and effect size within each organism and timepoint.

nodes.label: ma_plot
nodes.rationale: MA plot of mean expression vs log2FC to detect intensity-dependent fold-change bias.

nodes.label: mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays
nodes.rationale: GGally ggpairs matrix of pairwise mouse-mouse correlations across all timepoints.

nodes.label: my_dens
nodes.rationale: Custom ggplot density panel function used as the diagonal of ggpairs correlation panels.

nodes.label: my_point
nodes.rationale: Custom ggplot scatter panel function used as the lower triangle of ggpairs correlation panels.

nodes.label: pca_expression
nodes.rationale: PCA plot on expression matrix paired with log2FC PCA.

nodes.label: pca_log2fc
nodes.rationale: PCA plot on log2FC matrix (per-pathogen) to visualise sample clustering.

nodes.label: pca_log2fc_expression
nodes.rationale: Patchwork combining expression and log2FC PCA panels for each pathogen.

nodes.label: pca_qn
nodes.rationale: PCA of quantile-normalized values, compared against raw PCA to judge normalization benefit.

nodes.label: pca_raw
nodes.rationale: PCA of raw expression/log2FC values (outer product) used to expose outlier samples.

nodes.label: rle_plot
nodes.rationale: Relative Log Expression boxplot per sample detecting sample-level outliers.

nodes.label: sa_plot
nodes.rationale: SA plot of mean expression vs standard deviation to examine mean-variance relationship.

nodes.label: scatter_plot_data
nodes.rationale: Wide-format per-participant log2FC matrix feeding ggpairs correlation scatterplots.

nodes.label: theme_vaxgo
nodes.rationale: Shared project ggplot theme applied to every figure for visual consistency.

nodes.label: volcano_data
nodes.rationale: Volcano plot data derived from averaged log2FC with -log10 adjusted p-value and Up/Down/NS significance labels (threshold logp > 2).

nodes.label: volcano_plot_raw_qn
nodes.rationale: Faceted volcano figure (Day x organism x measure) summarising differential expression.

nodes.label: cor.test
nodes.rationale: Base R Pearson correlation test with confidence intervals used for cross-species comparisons.

nodes.label: prcomp
nodes.rationale: Base R principal component analysis used to project samples on PC1/PC2.

nodes.label: long_expr_log2fc_avg
nodes.rationale: Average and dispersion statistics are aggregated per gene x pathogen x organism x timepoint to summarise mean-variance and log2FC relationships for QC.

nodes.label: outliers
nodes.rationale: Samples with PC1 > 100 are flagged as outliers in the PCA of log2FC and saved for downstream exclusion.

nodes.label: df_genes2GSEA
nodes.rationale: Genes are ranked with a composite metric (log2FC x -log(adj_p_val)) before running GSEA.

nodes.label: gsea_btm_results_core_joined
nodes.rationale: Classifies each leading-edge gene as Shared, Human only or Mouse only by joining the two organisms' core enrichment sets.
